# A meadow tree: a rose-wood trunk and a crown of three faceted balls. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Bark --base-color 0.7961 0.3020 0.4078 --no-slot
material new Crown --base-color 0.3569 0.7020 0.3804 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Trunk --vertices 6 --radius 0.22 --depth 2.2 --location 0 0 1.1
material assign Bark
add mesh ico-sphere --name C1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 1.3 --location 0 0 2.9
add mesh ico-sphere --name C2 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.95 --location 0.85 0.2 2.35
add mesh ico-sphere --name C3 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.9 --location -0.8 -0.2 2.45
select C1 C2 C3
active C1
join
rename C1 Crown
material assign Crown
select all
shade flat
export tree.glb
